lines.text: I'm sorry, I still have work to attend to.
I'm feeling a bit overworked, but it's nothing I'm not used to.
I need to be ready at all times.
... Would you like to have a cup of coffee?
The coffee just doesn't taste the same without the Commander here.
... Won't you go with me for a walk today?

You look busy.
Better busy than idle.
Are you... making me a cup of coffee?
The railway station facilities here are better than I expected.
Need to schedule during my time at the Outpost... Oh did you call me?
I can see the AZX after I reach the railway station.
I choose the best route and make sure it's delivered safely.
This may make me more efficient at work.
AZX is picking up speed.
There's no such thing as being overprepared.
Thank you, I'll put it to good use!
You clearly put a lot of thought into this, thank you.
I'll repay you someday, I promise.
How frustrating! Even when I'm working, I can't get the Commander out of my head.
I can't focus on work... I keep thinking about the Commander.
I don't get it... I feel so nervous when I'm around the Commander.
It's ready to run.
Which way should we go?
Route established. Ready to go.
Obstacles up ahead! Prepare for impact!
I'll get rid of it at once.
Enemy spotted, look alive!
Let me show you what the AZX can do.
Straighten out before starting.
Reloading.
Start when you are ready.
AZX is ready!
Aim for the target! Maximum output! Fire!
Send them back to hell where they belong!
Processing finished.
Next.
Clearing obstacles.
Ah!
Urgh...
Ugh...
Sorry... the train is temporarily inoperable.
It was a great ride.
